title: Brim: the bottle you'll actually carry

scenes.headline: Meet Brim
scenes.narration: Meet Brim. The reusable water bottle made for people who are always on the move.

media.query: sleek water bottle on a desk in morning light

scenes.headline: Fill it once. Go all day.
scenes.narration: A wide mouth makes filling and cleaning easy. A leak-resistant lid keeps your bag dry. Brim is built to go wherever your day does.
scenes.body: Wide mouth, leak-resistant lid, easy to clean.

scenes.headline: Made for real life
scenes.narration: Brim fits most cup holders, clips to a backpack, and comes in colors that make it easy to spot. Simple things that make you reach for it every day.

scenes.headline: One bottle, thousands of refills
scenes.narration: Every refill is one less single-use bottle. Brim is made to last, so the habit sticks and the waste doesn't.

scenes.headline: Brim. Drink to your brim.
scenes.narration: Brim. Fill up and keep going. Coming soon.
